question_cn: 三兵对三兵，双方兵形相同时，决定胜负的最重要因素是：
question_en: Three vs. three pawns with equal pawn structure — the most important deciding factor is:

options.text_en: Who moves the king first (tempo advantage)

options.text_cn: 王的位置——谁的王更靠近中心或关键格
options.text_en: King position — whose king is closer to the center or key squares

explanation_cn: 三兵对三兵的终极元思维：兵形相同时王的位置就是全部。王靠近中心 → 能支援任意方向 → 掌握主动权。这是整个兵残局系列中"王活跃性"原则的最直接体现。
explanation_en: Ultimate meta-concept in 3v3 pawn endings: with equal pawn structure, king position is everything. Centralized king → can support any direction → controls the initiative.
